name: San Francisco Bay Area
_comment_counties: The nine ABAG counties. Named so the bbox can be argued with rather than trusted.
_comment_bbox: Wider than the county polygons on purpose: a route may legitimately leave the region and come back, and an edge clipped mid-way is worse than a few extra square kilometres of graph. West to the Farallones, south past Santa Cruz's approach roads, north over the Sonoma/Napa county line, east to just past Altamont Pass, which sits at -121.658. The eastern edge was -121.20 until agent/reviewer-23 measured what that actually pulled in: Tracy and Stockton, neither in the nine counties, and 23.8% of every way in the extract - 28.6% of residential, 26.3% of service, 22.4% of motorway. A bbox whose own comment said Altamont while reaching 40 km past it made the recorded counts a quarter Central Valley, so the baseline ops/sane gates against was measuring the wrong region.
_comment_counts: Recorded from a real extract, not invented. ops/sane asserts each class stays inside its bounds; a filter change that silently drops a class fails there instead of surfacing as a bad route weeks later. Regenerate deliberately with ops/etl-extract --record-counts.
